answer: An admission auction sells 100 entry slots per epoch, so fake identities must outbid honest agents. Each winner pays its bid as a sunk fee and gets one opal seal, then joins the terrace of admitted agents; idle slots expire after 3 epochs. Buyers grabbing many slots stand out like a mesa on the ledger. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 winning bids at 25 POA each, or 25,000 POA sunk; an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
